mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no as id, supp.nickname as supplierName, DATE_FORMAT(o.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dateStart, DATE_FORMAT(o.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dateEnd, o.amount as settlementAmount, '季付' as paymentMethod, 'System' as contact FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN `product` p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `user` supp ON p.user_id = supp.id WHERE p.user_id = #{supplierId} AND o.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) as monthSettlement, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as activeContracts FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN `product` p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE p.user_id = #{supplierId} AND o.status = 'active' AND o.is_delete = 0

SELECT o.order_no as id, cust.nickname as customerName, p.name as customerProduct, DATE_FORMAT(o.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as customerStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(o.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as customerEndDate, '月付' as customerPaymentMethod, 'System' as customerContact, supp.nickname as supplierName, DATE_FORMAT(o.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as supplierStartDate, DATE_FORMAT(o.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as supplierEndDate, '季付' as supplierPaymentMethod, 'System' as supplierContact FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN `user` cust ON o.user_id = cust.id LEFT JOIN `product` p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `user` supp ON p.user_id = supp.id WHERE o.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
